questions.question: In calendar year 2020, what was the total amount paid out in Hospital Insurance benefit payments (in millions)?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_hi_trust_fund_operations.xlsx', sheet_name='HI', header=None)
year_col = 0
benefit_col = 9
row = df[df[year_col] == 2020]
result = int(row[benefit_col].values[0])

questions.question: Did the Hospital Insurance Trust Fund end calendar year 2008 with a larger total balance than it did in 2007?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_hi_trust_fund_operations.xlsx', sheet_name='HI', header=None)
balance_col = 13
bal_2007 = df.loc[df[0] == 2007, balance_col].values[0]
bal_2008 = df.loc[df[0] == 2008, balance_col].values[0]
result = 'yes' if bal_2008 > bal_2007 else 'no'

questions.question: Which calendar year recorded the largest single-year drop (most negative net change) in the Hospital Insurance Trust Fund between 2000 and 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_hi_trust_fund_operations.xlsx', sheet_name='HI', header=None)
df_data = df[pd.to_numeric(df[0], errors='coerce').between(2000, 2023)].copy()
net_change_col = 12
min_row = df_data.loc[pd.to_numeric(df_data[net_change_col]).idxmin()]
result = str(int(min_row[0]))

questions.question: How many calendar years from 1966 through 2023 experienced a negative net annual change in the Hospital Insurance Trust Fund?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_hi_trust_fund_operations.xlsx', sheet_name='HI', header=None)
df_data = df[pd.to_numeric(df[0], errors='coerce').between(1966, 2023)].copy()
net_change_col = 12
count = (pd.to_numeric(df_data[net_change_col]) < 0).sum()
result = int(count)

questions.question: What were the three calendar years with the highest total income for the Hospital Insurance Trust Fund between 2015 and 2020?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd
import json

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_hi_trust_fund_operations.xlsx', sheet_name='HI', header=None)
df_data = df[pd.to_numeric(df[0], errors='coerce').between(2015, 2020)].copy()
income_col = 8
top3 = df_data.sort_values(by=income_col, ascending=False).head(3)
result = [str(int(yr)) for yr in top3[0].tolist()]

questions.question: What is the difference in millions between payroll tax receipts in 2022 and 2021?
questions.program:

df = pd.read_excel('cms_trustees_hi_trust_fund_operations.xlsx', sheet_name='HI', header=None)
payroll_col = 1
tax_2021 = df.loc[df[0] == 2021, payroll_col].values[0]
